source_correspondence: L1 proves explicit coercivity with all complex lower coefficients and complete surjectivity by closed range and orthogonal complement; both energy domains are unchanged.
L2 uses the full SF16 complex form defect and actual natural-dual source; the lower tester is explicitly elliptic and the quarter absorption has its exact constants.
L3 uses actual QR regularizers and supported V limits, a finite half-order nest at each real target, and the same terminal region for every smoothness order.
L4 cancels the normal principal and every lower term before integration; only tangential derivatives and the added mass remain, with no discarded boundary functional.
L5 proves the exact natural-dual s+1 to L2 s reduction using SF5 with one ordinary tangential derivative, and preserves the energy front at target s.
L6 proves graph-norm density by inward translation, convolution and cutoffs, then the negative-half trace inequality and the exact Green sign.
L7 derives the graph equation for the actual complex flux Dx v + mx v; the H1 domain forces zero weak flux and the H1_0 domain retains zero solution trace.
L8 uses only original compact local tests, fixed plateau supports and the exact normalized coordinate/dual transformation.
Three complete exercises verify a pure boundary lift, an omitted complex lower boundary pairing and sharp weak trace order; 130 finite cases supplement the proofs.
The normal commutant, its regularized estimates, incoming errors and full strict propagation remain unfinished. No ordinary normal smoothing or pairing of arbitrary rough traces is claimed.
antecedents: The linked U057–U062 components retain their exact Hörmander III Section 18.3 and Vasy credits. This source-lift and trace proof is developed from those complete programme arguments, not attributed as an unchecked external theorem.
